title: Cumulative Meta-Learning from Active Learning Queries for Robustness to Spurious Correlations

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating minority-group test accuracy on vision datasets (Waterbirds, MNIST-CIFAR Dominoes, SpuCo) to measure a model's reliance on irrelevant artifact or background features instead of core, generalizable features.
Evaluating minority-group test accuracy on the CivilComments text classification dataset to measure whether the model spuriously correlates toxicity labels with the mention of demographic identities.
